rationale: Review started 2026-11-10T06:54:52Z and ended 2026-11-10T07:05:36Z (UTC). I re-hashed jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11728.txt and EO_13294.txt (both match, as do all source fingerprints), confirmed the spans, and read EO 11728 (38 FR 18861, signed July 12, 1973) in full, confirming identity: its only content restates section 104(b)(1) of EO 11157 (2 hours of aerial flight in a calendar month, with carry-over from the preceding five months), and it has no own-terms end. Under the 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling the restated clause continues, amended, until the parent order ends, so any later re-amendment of section 104(b)(1) before 2003 would not change the status. EO 13294 Sec. 2 (signed March 28, 2003, 68 FR 15919) states 'Executive Order 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, and Executive Order 11800 ... are hereby revoked'; the words 'as amended' reach the clause EO 11728 inserted and the whole of it, and Sec. 1 delegates the 37 U.S.C. 301, 301a and 301c authority directly to the Secretaries, so the subject continues under EO 13294 rather than EO 11728. A cruden number search found no other held text citing EO 11728, the U.S. Code and eCFR searches had 0 hits, and the Table IV listing at 37 U.S.C. 301 note has no printed note and supplies no current predicate; I found no revival of EO 11157. The recommended status NO is supported by held sources through 2026-10-14.
